findings.explanation: Lean proves `FAPPLY (FEMPTY : fmap Nat Bool) 0 = ARB` by `rfl`. In HOL4, applying the empty map gives `OUTL (INR one)`. The saved equation for `OUTL` covers only `OUTL (INL x) = x` (`sumScript.sml:287`), so HOL4 leaves its value on `INR one` open. All absent keys share that value, but identifying it with `ARB` adds an equation.
findings.repair:
opaque outlInrOne {β : Type v} [Nonempty β] : β := Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty β)

def FAPPLY {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [Nonempty β] (f : fmap α β) (x : α) : β :=
  match f.rep x with
  | some y => y
  | none => outlInrOne
findings.lean_check:
import CandleLean.Prelude.FiniteMap

example : HOL.FAPPLY (HOL.FEMPTY : HOL.fmap Nat Bool) 0 = HOL.ARB := rfl
findings.hol4_check: FAPPLY (FEMPTY : num |-> bool) 0 = OUTL (INR one : bool + one)
